title: Candy Advent Calendar for Kids
description:
This listing offers 5 different options for candy advent calendars! 

For each calendar, you will have a choice of sweet candy, sour candy only, or a mix or both sour and sweet candy. Candies will vary, but things that may be included are gumballs, warheads, mini poprocks packages, etc. None of the calendars will include chocolate.

Each calendar will come with one random piece of small candy per day, from December 1st to December 24th. However, if you purchase the "Box" or "Christmas House" option, your child will receive a ringpop on Christmas.

Dimensions for each option:

Hanging Advent - 16" x 14" (when hanging, 22.5" x 14")
Little Xmas Tree - 15" x 13"
Big Xmas Tree - 17.5 x 15"
Box Shaped Advent - 15.75" x 10.5"
Christmas House - 15.75" x 15.75"

Please be aware that we assume no responsibility for allergies.

title: Halloween Real Money Sticker, Custom Pumpkin Dollar Sticker

title: Lakehouse Cork Coasters
description:
Please read through the description for details about the coasters. 

These coasters come with the design shown in the picture; however, if you'd like a custom change, you can send me a message and I'll price out a quote and create a custom listing for you. 

These designs are laser engraved onto a cork coaster that is 1/5" thick and has a 4" diameter. Cork is a prime material for coasters as it absorbs liquid rather than just lets it pool. These coasters are excellent if you want a fun new set of coasters, but they also make excellent gifts! 

Interested in other designs? Visit our shop page! There are other coaster designs available for purchase, and more will be added.
